retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast retro-disco composition featuring vibrant yellow roller skates, blue spandex, and multi-colored ribbons against a dark background, framed by a vertical Japanese-style sidebar.
triggerTerms: obi strip layout with neon accents

recipe.visualDefinition: A dynamic, low-angle photograph of a roller skater in bright yellow boots and blue leggings, entangled in glossy pink, yellow, and blue ribbons, set against a deep black void with a structured vertical information panel on the left.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast relationship between the black background and saturated primary-colored subjects
Horizontal movement of ribbons contrasting with the verticality of the left-side sidebar
Diagonal thrust of the skater's legs creating a sense of motion
Textural contrast between glossy vinyl boots and matte spandex
coreInvariants: Vibrant yellow roller skates with red wheels
Multi-colored satin-finish ribbons wrapping the legs
Solid black background to isolate the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The skater's legs and skates occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame, scaled to dominate the central and right areas.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright yellow roller boot in the lower right foreground acts as the primary visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal line of the legs from top-right to bottom-left, then is pulled across by the horizontal ribbons.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black negative space surrounds the subject on the right and top, providing extreme contrast.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Electric Blue and Magenta (Leggings and Ribbons)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation and high value for the subjects against a zero-value background.

letterConstructionRules: Display text uses a script with sharp, lightning-bolt-like terminals
Secondary text uses a heavy, wide geometric sans-serif
Vertical sidebar text uses traditional Japanese Gothic and Mincho styles
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' and 'H' in the script have elongated, sharp descenders and ascenders
The horizontal bar behind the title has rounded ends
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between fluid, expressive script and rigid, vertical Japanese typesetting.

preserve: The sharp, angular nature of the script
The high-contrast color blocks in the sidebar
avoid: Serif fonts for the display text
Horizontal layout for the sidebar information

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid but sharp energy of the main title
Matches the density and weight of the sidebar metadata

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a person's legs in bright blue spandex and vibrant yellow roller skates with red wheels, entangled in glossy pink and yellow ribbons, set against a solid black background with studio lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a white vertical sidebar on the left containing blue and black text in a vertical orientation. Place a stylized script title in the top right quadrant over a horizontal yellow and pink bar.

verificationChecks: Is there a vertical sidebar on the left?
Does the script text have sharp, angular terminals?

mustAchieve: High-gloss finish on ribbons and boots
Extreme contrast between subject and background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the yellow of the skates is the most luminous element.
Verify the vertical sidebar does not overlap the main subject's feet.
Check that the ribbons appear to have a physical, glossy texture.
Confirm the script text is legible against the background elements.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [High-Contrast Studio Photography] + [Saturated Primary Palette] + [Japanese Obi Strip Layout] + [Sharp Retro Script].
